let n := a.size
  let dp := Id.run do
    let mut dp := Array.mkArray n 1
    for i in [1:n] do
      for j in [0:i] do
        if a[j]! < a[i]! then
          let newVal := intMax (dp[i]!) (dp[j]! + 1)
          dp := dp.set! i newVal
    return dp
  match dp with
  | #[] => 0
  | _   => dp.foldl intMax 0
